sourceConclusions: For admitted native readonly 01/20 turns, runTurn creates one runtimeBudget with captureProviderAccounting. Ledger-marker capture requires identity, bearer and service-secret bindings before dispatch.

Gather, forced synthesis, recursive critic/synthesis and core enforce-repair callers retain that runtimeBudget. The new core fetch observes the actual adapter request rather than reserving an approximate outer request.

OpenAI capture requests select service_tier default before serialization and byte reservation, reject unsupported top-level state, multimodal items and hosted tools, and accept only the exact qualified endpoint with redirects disabled.

Core retries and configured fallback use actual wire provider/model, final prepared output ceiling including the 8192 floor, and full serialized input bytes. The outer approximate reservation/settlement is skipped only for this armed capture path.

API Titan capture rejects non-us-east-1 regions and uses the explicit regional Bedrock runtime endpoint with maxAttempts one. NVIDIA capture requires the canonical hosted URL for the chosen model and disallows redirects.
Existing exact-price admission remains the authority for priced provider/model/kind tuples. Unknown provider prices reject before provider dispatch.
Ordinary non-capture branches retain prior configuration, request and accounting behavior. No provider/model selection or capture-admission gate is widened.
